summary.en: I am Caiyang Yu, a lecturer in the College of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at Wenzhou University. My work focuses on machine learning in real-world systems, with interests in multimodal understanding and efficient AI. I enjoy translating research ideas into reliable tools and practical collaborations.
summary.zh: 我是俞彩阳，现任温州大学计算机与人工智能学院讲师。我的研究聚焦于机器学习在真实场景中的应用，重点关注多模态理解与高效 AI。我希望把研究想法转化为可靠工具与可落地合作。
